_comment: Settings for scripts/fetch_instagram_dms.py and scripts/run_pipeline.py. Read at run time, no code change needed.
_chrome_profile_comment: A Chrome profile used only by this automation. Lives outside the repo because it holds the Instagram login cookie.
_open_unread_comment: false = never open a thread Instagram shows as unread, so the lead never sees 'Seen' from the automation. The thread is picked up on a later run once someone has read it. Requests are always safe to open: Instagram does not tell the sender until you accept.
_pacing_comment: Seconds, randomised inside each range. Human pace is the main protection against the account being flagged.
